correctness.rationale: Starting from the Stanovnik–Moškon–Mraz exact SQN integer recurrence, fix a=x1≤b=y1 and relax x2,x3,x4 to r,s,t∈[0,1]. The normalized objective F is a rational polynomial with multidegree (6,3,2,1). Independently constructed its exact Bernstein transforms: 168 coefficients of p(1-p)^5-F on p∈[0,1/5], all nonnegative (min0); eight halfboxes of (r,s,t) for 1024/15625-F on p∈[1/5,1/2], all 168 coefficients nonnegative (all mins≥0). Independently expanded integer q=5k+j, k≥2, j=0..4, and verified every polynomial coefficient of 15625*k*(4k+j)^5-1024*(5k+j)^6 after k=h+2 is ≥0. This is an exact rational polynomial proof for ALL q≥10, not a finite sample. Original certificate.json/verify.py and RESULT.md checked.
